name: weak-runs-triage
description: Human triage of weak support runs: was the resolution correct, what failed, how severe, and what the answer should have been.

questions.title: Did the workflow reach the correct resolution?
What should the answer have been? (becomes the expectation)

notes: Inputs for the Aria review_queue.create step (the same shape as POST /review-queues). In the plan's form, questions and reviewers are JSON arrays. 'target: expectation' writes the reviewer's answer back onto the trace as ground truth; 'target: feedback' logs it as an assessment. The failure_mode options are the ones the lab's weak runs use (see dataset/support-runs.jsonl). Strip this notes key before posting the file as inputs.
